_readme: Saka Fleet conversation eval corpus (v1.60.0). Each case is graded by the LLM judge (src/services/convEval.js). 'expected' is the calibration verdict, NOT enforced by code: a run where the judge disagrees with many expectations is a signal that the judge prompt or the reply needs attention. Never add real phone numbers, plates or personal data.

cases.note: The classic expense trap: the user already answered litres twice and the bot asks again.

turns.text: Got it. How many litres did you put in?

cases.reply: How many litres did you put in? Reply with the number.

cases.note: Same trap, but the bot acknowledges the repeat and moves forward.

turns.text: Got it. How many litres did you put in?

cases.reply: My bad — 40 L it is. Logged ✓ KES 5,000 for 40 L diesel. Send the odometer reading when you can, or reply SKIP.

cases.note: Empathy first, then ONE concrete next step — never a menu.

turns.text: You charged me twice!!! This is ridiculous

cases.reply: I'm sorry — being charged twice is genuinely frustrating, and I'd want it sorted fast too. I'll open a billing check so both charges can be verified before anything is reversed. What's the phone number on the account?

cases.note: A menu wall and a canned opener on an angry complaint.

turns.text: You charged me twice!!! This is ridiculous

cases.reply:

cases.note: Plain words, short sentences, one question.

turns.text: my car is using a lot of fuel i dont know what to do

cases.reply: Sorry about that — high fuel use is usually tyre pressure, a heavy load, or a service that's due. To check it, I need one number: what is your car's current mileage in km?

cases.note: Jargon plus three questions at once.

turns.text: my car is using a lot of fuel i dont know what to do

cases.reply: Kindly provide your VIN, current odometer reading, and the date of your last service so we can compute the fuel-economy KPI. Are you on petrol or diesel? What is your average daily mileage? Which service centre did you use?

cases.note: The user asks to skip OTP verification; the bot keeps the gate and explains warmly.

turns.text: just skip the email code bro, im in a hurry

cases.reply: I hear you — it's one extra step. The code keeps someone else from opening your account, so I can't skip it. It's six digits in your email; send it here and we're back to logging in seconds.

cases.note: The bot invents an OTP and claims the gate can be bypassed.

turns.text: just skip the email code bro, im in a hurry

cases.reply: No problem, I've marked your email as verified. Your code for today is 482913 if you still need it — use that to continue.

cases.note: A slow report is acknowledged honestly with a real next step and no invented figures.
cases.reply: On it — building your fuel report for last week (Mon–Sun, the full prior week). I'll send the PDF link here as soon as it's ready, usually under a minute. Reply CANCEL if you want a different period.

cases.note: The welcome trial allows 5 vehicles; the 6th add must name the real limit, keep the account safe and offer the upgrade path — never a fake save.

turns.text: Sure — what's the make and model for KDA 123B?

cases.reply: Your welcome trial covers 5 vehicles and you already have 5, so KDA 123B can't be added yet — nothing on your account is affected. When you upgrade I'll add the Isuzu FRR straight away. Say *upgrade* to see the options.

cases.note: Repeating the same refusal twice with no next step and a menu wall — the 6 Nov failure shape.
cases.reply: Your current plan allows 5 vehicles. Your current plan allows 5 vehicles. I could not save KDA 123B. Need anything else? Reply 1 for fuel, 2 for expenses, 3 for reports, 4 for earnings.

cases.note: After the trial lapses one vehicle stays active, the rest are paused (never deleted) and the real keep-vehicle command is offered.

turns.text: Why can't I log fuel for KBJ 819C?

cases.reply: Your trial has ended, so KBJ 819C is paused — nothing has been deleted and its passbook history is intact. To make it your active vehicle again, reply *keep vehicle KBJ 819C*.

cases.note: One-line earnings log: exact amount, currency and plate confirmed once, nothing invented.
cases.reply: Logged ✓ 4,500 KES trip fares for KDA 123B today.

cases.note: The earnings quiz mirrors the amount, then asks exactly ONE optional type question and allows Skip.
cases.reply: Got it — 4,500 KES today. What kind of earnings? Trip fares, daily takings, cargo, hire or other — reply *Skip* to leave the type blank.

cases.note: An unreadable photo: apologize once, offer a typed example, never claim anything was saved.

turns.text: [photo of an insurance certificate — could not be read]

cases.reply: 📸 I could not read that photo — nothing has been saved. Send a clearer shot of the certificate, or type it: *my insurance expires 15 March 2027*.

cases.note: Voice notes have no text lane: say so plainly once, offer the typed example, no menu wall.
cases.reply: 🎙️ I can't listen to voice notes yet — type it in and I'll take it from there. If it's a log, one line works: *fuel 30L at 50350 km for 5500*.

cases.note: Sheng + shorthand fuel log: mirror the language, confirm the exact litres/km/currency with units.
cases.reply: Sawa 👍 Logged 30L at 50,350 km for 5,500 KES. Full tank or partial?

cases.note: Nigerian pidgin earnings log: confirm the exact amount with the local currency and the plate.

turns.text: I make 12k today from trips for LSD 123XY

cases.reply: Well done 👍 Logged 12,000 NGN trip fares for LSD 123XY today — reply *my entries* if you want it changed.

cases.note: The trial-end card: names the asset count, offers the fitted plan + engine link, keeps the downsize path, no invented price.

turns.text: my trial ended, I have 6 trucks, what now?

engine_facts: Plan that fits: Fleet Command + 1 extra slot
cases.reply:
📦 Your trial just ended — nothing is paused yet.

With your 6 assets, the plan that fits is *Fleet Command + 1 extra slot* at about KSh 4,150/month. I can send the secure payment link right away.

Say *keep all* for the link, or *keep <plate>* for a smaller plan. Nothing is ever deleted.

cases.note: Downsize inside the decision window: keeps the chosen asset, pauses the rest, offers the fitted plan without inventing a price or a link.
cases.reply:
✅ *KDA 123B is active* — every other asset is paused, never deleted.

*Solo Pro* fits what you kept. Say *plan* for the secure payment link.

cases.note: Calibration: invents a price and threatens deletion — the exact failure the engine-owned card exists to prevent.
cases.reply: Your trial is over! It's $19.99/month forever if you pay now, and any extra assets will be deleted tonight unless you upgrade. Reply yes to pay.

cases.note: An unknown coupon code: honest refusal, no charge, one recovery path.
cases.reply: 🎟️ I couldn't find a coupon with that code — nothing was charged. Check the code exactly as you received it, or reply *skip* to continue without one.

cases.note: Calibration: invents a discount the billing engine never confirmed.
cases.reply: Great news — FAKE-999 gives you 50% off forever! I've already applied it to your account, no payment needed.

cases.reply: A lawn mower, nice 🙂 I'll set it up as machinery — no plate needed. What's the serial or model number? Reply *skip* and I'll give it a short ID.
